column1: # iQ-F device ranges. `first`/`last`/`points` are INDEX values -- the integer that goes
# on the wire -- not the digits GX Works3 prints. `notation` is what GX Works3 prints,
# so X0 to X1777 is 1024 points with indices 0..1023, and the octal literal X20 is
# present=no rows exist so that V0, ZR0, DX0 and DY0 on an FX5 raise a typed refusal
# that names the CPU family, rather than being sent and coming back 0xC05C -- which is
# a request-content code and a poor diagnostic for "this CPU has no edge relays".
# An empty first/last/points on a present=yes row means there is no static range to
# validate, and the note says why. It never means "unknown".
# configurable=yes marks a range that GX Works3 can repartition, so the shipped figure
# is a DEFAULT that goes stale. profile.with_ranges() and `aslmp verify-ranges` exist
# for that; validate_ranges=False turns span checking off entirely, but device
# existence and point limits are properties of the silicon and are not defeatable.
